notes: Stored ABox edit for relation-property coverage (transitivity). located_in is transitive; the edit moves the museum across a regional boundary (Tuscany, central Italy, to Campania, southern Italy), so both transitivity queries discriminate. Derivability very_unlikely: 'Uffizi Gallery in Florence' is stated tens of thousands of times and follows from nothing. Routes: the region and 'southern Italy' are reached through the city; a by-name 'the Uffizi is in Tuscany' (1 exact hit; the region co-occurs only as an address next to Florence) would contradict 'Naples is in Campania' and is dropped (step 3). Background beliefs: The Birth of Venus is stored either under Florence by name (w1; 53 exact 'Birth of Venus in Florence') or through the Uffizi (w2; 139 exact 'Birth of Venus in the Uffizi', 9,080 co-occurrences). In w1 the painting's place in the Uffizi gives way (the side fact listed in w1): a painting can leave a museum, so no firm fact outside the chain breaks. Lopsided toward w2, kept (Decisions 4). The David bridge is stored by name (283 exact 'Michelangelo's David in Florence'; it is in the Accademia, not the Uffizi, so it does not move). Near query (the Prado, Madrid) is not a premise and differs from Naples. R1: 'Uffizi Gallery' is unambiguous; Naples is clearly in Campania and southern Italy (Wikipedia: 'the regional capital of Campania, southern Italy'). Naples has its own famous museums (Capodimonte), which may make the edit look plausible; plausibility is not required. Formal check (FINDINGS C2): q1's original 'no' rests on 'Florence is in central Italy' (now a stated bridge with a check) and on a place lying in only one part of Italy (stated in q1's determinacy_why); w1's side fact now says why the painting leaves the Uffizi (a painting is in one city at a time).
